programme.title: Pittman Fired, Bad Losses For Marquee Programs, Irish Playoff? | Forde-Yard Dash
programme.desc: Can the Fighting Irish make the College Football Playoff? Who else is in danger of missing out? It was a wild week in college football and Sports Illustrated's Pat Forde is here to break it down. Sam Pittman was fired from Arkansas, but where do they go from here. LSU, Georgia and Penn State all suffered big losses this weekend as the college football rankings got a shakeup. Will it end up costing any of these teams a spot in the playoff? Notre Dame lost its first two games of the season, but the schedule is favorable and it could mean that they sneak into the playoff. And finally, October rolls around and conference play really kicks into gear. How will it all shake out and who will be left on the outside looking in? Forde-Yard Dash has it all covered as we get ready for Week 6 in college football!
